cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a chestnut roasting stall — an iron roasting drum on coals, paper bags, a small wooden stool and fallen leaves
cuts.scene: she is the stall owner crouching by the roasting drum turning chestnuts with long tongs
cuts.outfit: a chestnut roaster look fitted to her body — a short quilted vest over a fitted knit crop top and short shorts with boots, bare midriff and legs, a spiky chestnut-burr brooch
